i.norm: Verifies that {@link ByteUtils#toLittleEndian(DataOutput, long, int)} writes exactly {@code length} bytes to the underlying stream, with the value encoded little-endian (lowest byte first) and the remaining higher bytes padded with zeros.
The method must write exactly the requested number of bytes.
Little-endian layout: the lowest byte (50) comes first, followed by (lengthInBytes - 1) zero bytes for the higher-order positions.
